title: Future: JMESPath listName pushdown optimizer
description:
Push down JMESPath list-filter clauses (e.g. listName == 'Work' at the top of a conjunction) to the EventKit factory predicate. Avoids fetching all reminders when the user expressed a list constraint inline in JMESPath.

Acceptance criteria:
- Inspect the parsed JMESPath AST (jmespath.swift exposes it).
- Detect a top-level filter projection whose root expression is &&-conjoined and contains listName == 'literal'.
- Push the list constraint to the EventKit factory predicate.
- Strip the corresponding clause from the JMESPath before evaluation.
- Refuse to push down if the listName clause is inside an OR (correctness).
- Document the optimization in docs/query-reference.md.
- Tests confirm equivalence: pushed-down vs un-pushed produce identical results.

description:
Polish the existing JMESPath-based query surface rather than introducing a custom parser. Three concrete UX improvements:

1. Replace `--from`/`--to` (auto-semantics, ambiguous) with explicit per-field flags: `--created-from`, `--created-to`, `--modified-from`, `--modified-to`, `--due-from`, `--due-to`.
